bit: It's Friday and I treated the end of the week like the autopsy never happened. Thirty-three packs. The Thursday autopsy is still warm. I brought another toilet joke to a door that unlocked on Monday and locked every night after because the calendar said so.

trailerGuy.setup: Friday is the open mic that thinks the weekend is a free pass after Monday.
trailerGuy.punch: Cut the thirty-three. Try: Friday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
tags: Friday energy, same toilets, same silence.
trailerGuy.button: Sacramento has a Friday. The mic doesn't forget the silence you bought on Monday just because the bars are open.
trailerGuy.verdict: Died as a calendar reset. Make Friday the comic who counted the locked nights and still showed up with the same joke.
fixedVersions: Friday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
The week is almost over. The toilets are not. The silence is still mine.
New day. Same week. I still haven't bombed in public.
